caption: Mandø, Mandø
composition: Brick church and a wooden bell frame on a marsh mound · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Mandø's small whitewashed church has no tower. It sits on a raised mound, with scrolled gables, a red-tiled roof, and a separate black-tarred wooden bell frame with a pyramidal roof just west of it. The night is mainly clear, about 12.8°C, over flat marsh and dark tidal flats. A few warm windows mark the low houses. The causeway is not the subject, and the tide was not checked.
